normal.label: Move for White
normal.emptyTitle: Type a move first, such as e4, Nf3 or e2e4.
normal.help: Type one move and press Enter. Castle with O-O; promote with a8=Q or a7a8n.
normal.error: That move is not legal here. Use e4, Nf3 or e2e4; include the piece for promotion, such as a8=N.
